item.title: Morocco Appoints Fatima Zahra Mansouri as Head of Government
item.description: Issue 7548 names Fatima Zahra Mansouri Head of Government, sets a 30-day online mortgage-release process for state housing aid, approves €585.53 million in foreign loans, and clears a new Tanger Med container terminal deal.

item.title: Morocco Seizes Olive Groves for the Bouaouan Dam
item.description: Land for the Bouaouan dam is expropriated, three foreign degrees get a path to Moroccan recognition, eight health institutes get fixed capacities, and the Left Alliance gets its ballot symbol for the 23 September 2026 election.
